releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.59 — three call fixes, all from real use. (1) Your own camera preview was a black rectangle even though the other person saw you perfectly: the self-view was a SurfaceView, which Android composites on its own layer, so a small tile inside a rounded, clipped frame came out as a black hole. It is now a TextureView, which is drawn like any other view — corners, clip and all — and it says "Starting camera…" until a real frame arrives instead of showing black. (2) Calls no longer hang themselves up: the screen used to time out mid-call, the connection blipped, and six seconds later the app ended the call for both people. The call screen now keeps the display awake, the recovery window is 30 seconds, and the call shows "Reconnecting…" while it heals. (3) The timer that ends a lost call is now properly cancelled when the connection comes back — it was only cancelled before the first connection, so a recovered call could still be killed afterwards.
